entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: An amusement park?

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: All the people seem to be in good spirits...[n]Are you sure this is the correct place?

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: You better not be wrong! If you are,[n]you're getting tortured SO hard!

entries.speaker: Thrill Ride Passengers
entries.en: *screams*

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Tha-That screaming...!

entries.speaker: Thrill Ride Passengers
entries.en: *screams*

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: What is happening here!?
It's a thrill ride.
It's the latest torture device.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: ...A "thrill ride"? Is it more terrifying than[n]a guillotine?

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: No, wait—this is an amusement park.[n]Is it some kind of entertainment?

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: We must determine whether or not this[n]place is beneficial to your rehabilitation.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: It only follows that we experience this[n]for ourselves.

entries.speaker: Thrill Ride Passengers
entries.en: *screams*

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Are you serious, Justine? Are we really[n]getting on this?

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: What could be the matter? You're not[n]scared... are you?

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Ha, like some human contraption could[n]scare me! C-C'mon, Inmate! Lead the way!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: AAAAAAH!!!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: We're falling we're falling we're FALLING!!!

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Caroline...

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Ahh, I'm gonna die! We're all dead!!!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Ah! Wha... Ahhh... Waaaaaah!!! *sob*

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: AAAAAAH!!!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Guhhh... Urp! Hoo... *inhale* *exhale *[n]*inhale* *exhale*
You okay there?
You barely survived.
Pathetic...

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Yeah... I thought I was dead—

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: I-I mean, I'm fine, obviously! I merely[n]wished to experience your torture device[n]so I could try to understand you humans!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Don't get the wrong idea, Inmate! I merely[n]wished to experience your torture device[n]so I could try to understand you humans!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: I bet an ordinary human would've died[n]back there!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: I-I was merely mocking the other humans![n]They're the pathetic ones!

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Perhaps you're simply weak-willed,[n]Caroline? I wonder if you truly possess[n]the aptitude to fulfill a warden's duties...

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Dammit, I'll show YOU who's weak-willed!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: I saw some "haunted house" thing back[n]there—you're going in with me!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Let's move, Justine!

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Very well.

entries.speaker: Mummy
entries.en: Mrrrrrrrr...!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Eh? You dead or something? Fine,[n]I'll help ya out—Samarecarm.

entries.speaker: Lantern-Swinging Ghost
entries.en: Bleeeehhhhh!

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Eeeek! Stay back! Makarakarn! Garudyne!

entries.speaker: TV-Exiting Ghost\n
entries.en: Guhhhhh...

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: What's going on with your joints?[n]Here, lemme fix those.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: ...Ugh, what even happened to you?[n]I'm just going to do these all at once—[n]Mediarahan.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: That was nothing but a bunch of injured[n]and deceased people. Was that just a[n]hall for this place's torture victims?

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Oh, and Justine—who's weak of spirit now?

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: I saw you nearly use Megidolaon on that[n]woman near the end!

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: I was merely annoyed by her popping out[n]of that hatch just to stick her face in mine!

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: If there's an exit sign above a door, you're[n]supposed to leave through it, not enter!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: I get it, I get it. No need to work yourself up.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: What I want to know now is, why do[n]humans create these frightening pastimes?
For the thrills.
To build mental fortitude.
Those weren't scary.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Oh, so it's all supposed to be entertaining?[n]Well, it's rather trivial to the likes of us.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: It is merely child's play.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Ah, I see... It does seem like it would make[n]for good training. Well, it's rather trivial[n]to the likes of us.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: It is merely child's play.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: O-Oh yeah, none of that was scary![n]You're right...

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Indeed. It was merely child's play.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Whatever the case may be, we've learned[n]the secret behind the screams, so let's[n]say this assignment's complete.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: I've gotta say, humans are pretty strange[n]creatures for actually wanting to be[n]scared.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: However, a metropolitan torture parlor[n]such as this seems well-suited for your[n]rehabilitation.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: ...In truth, we ought to accompany you[n]further, but this is enough rehabilitation[n]for us to witness today.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: But no slacking off, Inmate! If we find[n]out you're not trying your hardest,[n]you're gonna get haunted in your sleep!

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: You understand, yes? Now, escort us[n]back.
I escorted the twins back[n]to the Velvet Room...
